emptyScene.rule: features/map/sceneGeometry.ts hasGeometry(buildingId, { footprints, detail }): true when the footprints drawn hold one of this building with a polygon, or the detail of this building outlines at least one space. emptyScene.detailPresentMeans: useBuildingScene returns a detail object for every building that is a feature of its area, also for Tower 3 (one level, no space outline) and Magnolia (no level).
